cap_unit: minutes of wall time (elapsed real time, not CPU time)

baseline_check.rule: the shared-history rule of the project (nuaa_patience_verify.shared_history, criteria.shared_history_difference = 0 of nuaa_patience_verify.json): the five values of each of the first 3 epochs identical, difference 0, no tolerance, computed with one source, pad_arch_comparison.history_differences (a non-finite value, NaN or infinite, in the compared epochs stops the trial as FAIL with no outputs); per field the first epoch at which the two values differ (first_differing_epoch), the largest absolute difference (max_abs_difference) and the first epoch at which it is reached (epoch_of_max_abs_difference) are reported; in PR #29 the field first_differing_epoch held the epoch of the largest difference (our defect, corrected with a test on 19 November 2026)
baseline_check.consequence: the outcome is recorded and does not change the status of the trial; it is the first check of the copy of the trainer; in the plan the same check is repeated on every epoch of every one of the 24 LivenessNet trainings (against the accepted run at the same patience); if the history is not reproduced in the trial, the difference is reported and the pre-registration is not closed before it is explained

training.checkpoint: weights of the epoch with minimum val_loss on the dev frames (EarlyStopping restore_best_weights; set_weights when the epochs end first)
training.loss: CategoricalCrossentropy, one-hot labels (index 0 bona fide, 1 attack)
training.class_weight: balanced on the fitting set: n / (2 * n_class)
training.augmentation: RandomFlip(horizontal), RandomRotation(0.03), RandomZoom(0.12, 0.12), RandomTranslation(0.06, 0.06), RandomBrightness(0.15, value_range=(0, 1)), RandomContrast(0.2), GaussianNoise(0.02); fitting set only
training.seeds: train_seed for random, numpy and TensorFlow (weight initialisation, augmentation, batch order); no split seed: the folds and the samples are deterministic

process: one process for both networks, LivenessNet first: LivenessNet is then the first training of the process, as arm_b_fold1_seed42 was in the accepted run; the runs of the plan train many models in sequence in one process, as the accepted runs did; the inputs (about 2.5 GB of frames) are loaded and verified once; between the two networks the trainer calls clear_session and the previous model is released
test_read: no test frame is assembled or evaluated and no test score or metric is read, computed or written. check-inputs and trial read: the five M2 manifests (official_train, official_test, cnn_train, cnn_es and cnn_test: NUAA's official image lists and the cache order, read to index the cache and to check the rows of extracted_frames.csv against the official lists; official_test and cnn_test are not the test role of the folds); the cache, hashed whole with its label and subject members read (only trial loads its image arrays whole, in the frame store); the extracted frames file, loaded whole with the SHA-256 of every frame (both commands); these frame files also hold frames of the held-out subjects, but only the fitting and dev frames of arm B, fold 1 are assembled, by trial only (an explicit check refuses any other role); of the cells run status.json, the public and restricted SHA256SUMS, its configuration and the cell manifests of the arms and of the common dev; of the folds run status.json, the restricted SHA256SUMS and extracted_frames.csv (no public file opened); of the accepted run at patience 4 status.json, the restricted SHA256SUMS and one training card (arm_b_fold1_seed42); of the accepted run at patience 12 status.json and the restricted SHA256SUMS; the configurations of the two accepted runs and the LivenessNet architecture file; the fold schema (fold<k>_test.csv, the test role of the folds) is never loaded and no <model>_test_scores.csv, public aggregate or run record of any run is opened; plan reads only this configuration, the configurations of the two accepted runs, the code files pinned in this configuration and, if given, the status.json and trial.json of a trial; compare-trials reads only the status.json and trial.json of the two trials it compares

declarations.no_test: no test frame is assembled or evaluated and no test score or metric is read, computed or written in this delivery; as in the accepted runs the frame files (the cache and the extracted frames, which also hold frames of the held-out subjects) are hashed and loaded whole, but only the fitting and dev frames of arm B, fold 1 are assembled, and an explicit check refuses any other role; the fold schema (which holds the test role) is never loaded; no external dataset is touched
declarations.technical_trial: the trial measures time and memory; the histories it records are technical outputs, not results, and no metric is computed from them; the LivenessNet history is compared with the accepted card only as a check of the copy of the trainer
declarations.cpu_only: TensorFlow runs on the CPU only (the GPU is hidden before any operation: known tensorflow-metal defect that skips the ReLU after a Dense layer in graph mode), as in the accepted runs
declarations.no_checkpoint: no checkpoint is saved by the trial: the models live in memory for the inference passes and are then released
declarations.threads: the TensorFlow intra-op and inter-op threads are configured to 10 and 10 by the runner (training.threads, fixed by the coordinator on 19 November 2026 for the whole NUAA plan): set and read back through tf.config.threading right after TensorFlow is imported and before any TensorFlow operation; 'effective' is the value read back from the getters of tf.config.threading, not a measured size of the thread pools; the accepted runs did not set them and ran on an Apple M4 with 10 logical CPUs; on the Apple M5 Pro (15 logical CPUs) a trial with the TensorFlow defaults (20261118-ARCHTRIAL-0858ae7) did not reproduce the accepted LivenessNet history, while a trial with both values set to 10 through environment variables (20261119-ARCHTRIAL-b8e78b2, outside the repository) did; environment variables TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS or TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS that contradict the configuration are refused before any work; the requested and effective values, the environment variables found and the number of logical CPUs are recorded in status.json, trial.json and trial.md, and the record of each network holds the values read back before and after that network
